description: Integration tests for fetch_mta_sts_policy using wiremock or axum test server (no live network). Test cases: successful fetch returns body, HTTP redirect returns MtaStsError::PolicyFetchFailed (no follow), response > 64 KiB returns error, invalid TLS cert returns error, timeout returns error, RFC1918 IP blocked (mock resolver returning 192.168.1.1 should be rejected). Each test uses an independent mock server; no test calls live mta-sts endpoints.
title: Tests: MTA-STS policy HTTPS fetcher
